membership role

  • CURIE: gmeow:membershipRole
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipRole
  • Category: property

The role the pitch plays in this collection (tonic/finalis, vādī, samvādī, ghammāz, ascent-only, descent-only, ornamental, or generic member). Functional per relator: one role per membership.

Property shape: object property; gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership -> gmeow:CollectionMemberRole; functional
